proposals.before: Share the fisherman's coarse fare, then bathe and shake out your robe; leave what Xu You and Laozi held dear— take up the path of Peng Zu and Prince Xian!
proposals.after: Share the fisherman's coarse fare, then bathe and shake out your robe; leave what Xu You and Laozi held dear—take up the path Peng Xian left behind!
proposals.reason: Chinese 彭鹹 is the single figure Peng Xian; the idiomatic English wrongly splits the name into Peng Zu and Prince Xian.

proposals.before: Mingle with the fisherman's soup and drink; bathe clean and shake out your robe; cast aside what Xu You and Laozi treasured— follow the way Peng Zu and Prince Xian left behind!
proposals.after: Mingle with the fisherman's soup and drink; bathe clean and shake out your robe; cast aside what Xu You and Laozi treasured—follow the way Peng Xian left behind!
proposals.reason: Literal English also splits 彭鹹 into Peng Zu and Prince Xian; it should remain one name.

proposals.before: They mourn Lord Wen's wanderings, praise Yu at Dragon Gate, drown old flood sorrow in dredged channels, spread the nine rivers toward the eastern sea.
proposals.after: They sigh for Duke Wen and pity Jie Tui; they praise Yu at Dragon Gate, drown old flood sorrow in dredged channels, and spread the nine rivers toward the eastern sea.
proposals.reason: Chinese 愍推 names Jie Tui (介推); the idiomatic English omits 推 and collapses the couplet into Lord Wen's wanderings alone.

proposals.before: Some exalt Shennong and the like— are they the final model for emperors?
proposals.after: Some exalt Fu Xi and Shen Nong—are they the final model for emperors?
proposals.reason: Chinese 戲、農 names Fu Xi and Shen Nong; idiomatic English collapses them into 'Shennong and the like'.

decisions.reason: Focus unit 彭鹹之所遺 names the single Chu Ci figure Peng Xian and what he left behind; the prior idiomatic English wrongly splits 彭鹹 into Peng Zu and Prince Xian. The proposed repair restores the one name and keeps the surrounding Xu You / Laozi contrast intact.

The same focus phrase 彭鹹之所遺 is one personal name plus what he bequeathed; the prior literal English invents two figures, Peng Zu and Prince Xian. The proposed literal line correctly reads Peng Xian alone.

Focus couplet 嗟文公而愍推兮 pairs Duke Wen with 推 (Jie Tui), especially given the preceding view of Mount Jie; the prior idiomatic English drops 推 and invents Lord Wen's wanderings. The proposed repair restores both figures and matches 文公 as Duke Wen.

Focus unit 戲、農 abbreviates Fu Xi and Shen Nong as two named culture heroes; the prior idiomatic English collapses them into Shennong and the like, omitting 戲. Naming both Fu Xi and Shen Nong is the accurate repair.
